notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!

We have an have a new build that should address some of the issues that people were experiencing.[/h3]

[h3]Issues Addressed:[/h3]
[h3][olist]
[*] The Menu Glitch that lead to a soft-lock
[*] The fog glitch/crash that people were experiencing loading into a dungeon
[*] The blur has been toned down a bit without impacting performance
[/olist]
[/h3]
[h3]We are sorry it took so long for the people experiencing these issues! The issues proved to be very tricky to solve.[/h3]

notes.title: Death end re;Quest™ 2 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone, sorry for missing an announcement last week! We have a couple of things to share now though.

Firstly, we just want to give a reminder that [b]the game is releasing on August 18th![/b] 

We are just two weeks out now! :)[/h3]

[h2]Additionally, we would like say that the Death end re;Quest 2 Limited Edition is available for Pre-Order now on [url=https://www.iffysonlinestore.com/death-end-request-2-LE/]Iffy's Online Store[/url]![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961560/221145efda820e6068b2bf728978eace69446d6b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Additionally, we have put up the coming soon pages for the DLCs, you can get easy links to them from the  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266220/Death_end_reQuest_2/]Death end re;Quest 2 Store Page![/url][/h3]

[h3]That is all for the updates! We will post again at the end of the week with more screenshots! Don't for get to add Death end re;Quest 2 to your wish list![/h3]

notes.title: Death end re;Quest 2 Beta Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! We have begun testing of for the Closed Beta this week.


Thank you to everyone that applied! Sadly we cannot select everyone, and if you have not received an email of acceptance, you were not selected to participate in the beta.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961560/221145efda820e6068b2bf728978eace69446d6b.jpg[/img]


Stay tuned for more artwork posts and updates! Don't forget to wish list Death end re;Quest 2![/h3]
